thread:
jenna: Quick sync — planning to merge the docs set for the canary release next Tue morning. Need reviewers, CI preview checks, and decision on versioned docs bump.

mike: Which PRs are in scope? can you drop the list?

jenna: TL;DR: 3 PRs — examples update (PR #4123), migration guide for v0.9 -> v1.0 (PR #4131), and SDK snippet fixes (PR #4140). All linked here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+canary

sarah: For the migration guide, we need to gate the v1.0 section behind the feature flag docs_v1.0 until the rollout. Is that acceptable?

jenna: Yes — wrap it in the feature-flag callout and add admonition. We shouldn't publish v1.0 as the default yet.

tim: Cutoff for mergers? I propose Fri EOD PST to allow QA + staging preview on Mon. Otherwise we risk last-minute regressions.

mike: Fri EOD works. I'll own the examples PR review; pinging @sarah for migration guide review.

sarah: Ack, I can review migration guide on Thu morning. Quick heads-up: there are a couple of code snippets that need `client.generate` -> `client.chat.complete` rename.

jenna: Noted. @doc-ci-bot — can you trigger a docs-preview build after the PRs are updated? Need the preview link for QA.

doc-ci-bot: build queued for branch "canary-docs-merge" — preview URL will be posted when ready. Status: pending checks (link-check, md-lint, preview-build).

mike: For CI, please make sure link-check timeout is bumped to 60s for external links; several examples hit external mirrors.

jenna: Good call. I'll add that as a commit to each PR. Also, remember to add the release-note tag `docs:canary` so we can filter.

sarah: One more: migration guide references 'redwood-api v0.9' — we should add a small compatibility table and call out breaking changes. I'll add it in my review.

tim: Quick question about versioned docs: are we creating a /v1.0/ tree or just an in-page toggle? Product wants a v1 namespace to avoid confusion.

jenna: Product said yes to a /v1.0/ prefix for the major change. Implementation: leave current master as is, add a new versioned directory and keep canary behind the flag until GA.

mike: After approvals, what's merge cadence? Do we merge sequentially or bundle and merge all in a single window?

jenna: Bundle into one merge window early Tue 09:00 UTC — that matches traffic minima and gives the team time to rollback if needed. We'll merge when: all CI green, 2 reviewers approved (or 1 + docs-owner OK), and preview link validated.

sarah: I can be 1 reviewer, mike will be 2. If anything's blocking, react with :no_entry_sign: in-thread so we have a quick signal.

mike: I'll also run a quick spellcheck pass on the examples.

doc-ci-bot: preview built: https://deploy-preview-canary.redwood.dev/docs-canary-178345 — checks: link-check ✅, md-lint ✅, preview-build ✅

jenna: Nice — can everyone skim the preview and drop a +1 or :eyes: before Fri EOD? If no objections, I'll merge Tue 09:00 UTC.

tim: Will do. Marking calendar.

mike: +1.

sarah: :eyes: will finish the migration review Thu morning.

jenna: Thanks team. If any blocker pops up, flag here. Otherwise, see you at merge window. :shipit:
